texts.preamble: Independent Research Ethics Society vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 12 February, 2025
texts.facts: The petitioner alleges that the respondent no.7 is selling a food product under misleading brand name. 3. The petitioner refers to a communication dated 11th November, 2024 addressed to the petitioner by the Director of the Regulatory Compliance Division, Food Safety Standards Authority of India mentioning that the use of the name 'Doctor's Choice' is a misleading trademark by the Food Business Operator which poses a significant threat to consumer safety and health. 4. Prayer has been made to immediately stop the private respondent from selling the product with the said trade name and label.
texts.arguments: 5. Learned counsel representing the private respondent submits that the writ petition will not be maintainable here as the petitioner already has an alternative remedy. 8. Learned advocate representing the State respondents relies upon the communications made by the State Regulatory Authority intimating the petitioner that the license in favour of the private respondent is issued by the Central Government and, accordingly, it is the central authority that is to take steps in the matter.
